stemMd: At 25 °C, a solution has hydrogen-ion concentration 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹. What is its pH?
explanationMd: Apply the definition pH = −log₁₀[H⁺]. Since log₁₀(10⁻³) = −3, the pH is 3. A value below 7 at 25 °C is consistent with an acidic solution.

distractorRationale.b: The minus sign in pH = −log₁₀[H⁺] cancels the negative exponent.
distractorRationale.e: This would be the pOH under the stated temperature conditions.
distractorRationale.a: This is the concentration, not its negative logarithm.
distractorRationale.c: Neutral water has a different hydrogen-ion concentration.
